topic: How to Change a Flat Tire
sources_note: General vehicle maintenance guidance. Always follow your vehicle's own handbook.

intro.on_screen_text: How To Change A Flat Tire
intro.voiceover: How to change a flat tire in under ten minutes.

items.voiceover: Pull onto flat, solid ground. Hazard lights on, handbrake firmly set.
Loosen each wheel nut half a turn now, before you jack.
Jack only at the reinforced point marked in your handbook.
Lift until the flat clears the ground, then remove the nuts.
Fit the spare. Tighten the nuts by hand in a star pattern.
Lower the car, then torque them fully in the same star pattern.
Never put any part of yourself under a car held by a jack.

outro.on_screen_text: Most spares are space savers. Keep it under fifty miles an hour. 🚗 Tag a friend who needs to learn this. 👇 Consider yourself... Skillificationed.
outro.voiceover: Most spares are space savers. Keep it under fifty miles an hour.
